column1: # Certified correctly rounded FloatAP logarithm values, D84.
# precision_bits mode input_num input_den expected_num expected_den
# Source: centered_log existing 15 Rational inputs, 6 precision visits, 4 modes (360 checks).
# Each input value is independently rounded nearest-even to the original precision.
# Set B=2^1800. All integer fixed-point products and quotients are rounded outward.
# Sum y^(2k+1)/(2k+1) for k=0..1100. Upper remainder <= 4*y^(2205).
# The sign of log(x) is recovered by reversing bounds when x<1.
# Accept ONLY when lower and upper endpoints yield the SAME signed binary rounding.
# Modes: N nearest-even, D downward, U upward, Z toward zero.
# No GMP, MPFR, FloatAP or floating-point transcendental oracle used in generation.
# 284 unique data rows for 360 original checks.
# D96: log range reduction, cached log(2), boundary and cancellation probes.
